query: How can I improve my CIBIL credit score?
key_facts: Paying EMIs and credit card bills on time improves the CIBIL score
Keeping credit utilisation low and avoiding many loan enquiries helps
reference_answer: Your CIBIL score improves when you pay EMIs and credit card dues on time, keep credit utilisation low, and avoid frequent loan or card enquiries.

query: Money was debited but my UPI payment failed. What should I do?
key_facts: A failed UPI transaction is usually auto-reversed within 1 to 5 days
You can raise a complaint with your bank or on the NPCI dispute portal
reference_answer: As per the NPCI UPI FAQ, a failed UPI transaction where money is debited is normally auto-reversed within 1 to 5 days; if not, raise a complaint with your bank or on the NPCI dispute portal.

query: Do I need to file an income tax return if my income is below the exemption limit?
key_facts: Filing an ITR is mandatory if total income exceeds the basic exemption limit
Filing may still be required in cases like foreign assets or high deposits
reference_answer: According to the Income Tax Department, filing an ITR is mandatory if your total income exceeds the basic exemption limit, though it may also be required in specific cases such as large deposits or foreign assets.

query: What is PPF and what interest does it give?
key_facts: PPF is a 15-year government-backed savings scheme
Its interest rate is notified quarterly and interest is tax-free
reference_answer: The Public Provident Fund (PPF) is a 15-year government-backed savings scheme whose interest rate is notified quarterly, and both the interest and maturity amount are tax-free.

query: How can I identify and avoid UPI and online payment scams?
key_facts: A UPI PIN is needed only to send money, never to receive it
Never share OTP, PIN or click unknown payment links
reference_answer: The RBI advises that you never share your UPI PIN or OTP with anyone, since a PIN is required only to send money and not to receive it, and you should avoid clicking unknown payment links.

query: EMI समय पर न भरने पर क्या होता है?
key_facts: EMI बाउंस होने पर बैंक पेनल्टी और लेट फीस लगाता है
बार-बार चूक से CIBIL स्कोर गिर जाता है
reference_answer: RBI के अनुसार EMI समय पर न भरने पर बैंक लेट पेमेंट चार्ज लगाता है और बार-बार चूक होने पर आपका CIBIL स्कोर गिर जाता है, जिससे आगे लोन मिलना मुश्किल हो जाता है।

query: Term insurance aur endowment life insurance me kya difference hai?
key_facts: Term insurance gives only death cover with no maturity value
Endowment plans combine insurance with a savings/maturity benefit
reference_answer: IRDAI ke mutabik term insurance sirf death cover deta hai aur premium kam hota hai, jabki endowment life insurance plans insurance ke saath savings aur maturity benefit bhi dete hain.

query: Loan against property lene se pehle kya dhyan rakhna chahiye?
key_facts: Loan against property is a secured loan where your property is collateral
Defaulting can let the lender auction the property
reference_answer: RBI guidance ke anusaar loan against property ek secured loan hai jisme aapki property collateral hoti hai, aur default hone par lender property auction kar sakta hai, isliye repayment capacity dekh kar hi lein.

query: PAN card ஐ Aadhaar உடன் ஏன் இணைக்க வேண்டும்?
key_facts: Linking PAN with Aadhaar is required under Income Tax rules
An unlinked PAN becomes inoperative
reference_answer: Income Tax Department விதிப்படி PAN ஐ Aadhaar உடன் இணைக்காவிட்டால் PAN செயலிழந்து (inoperative) போகும், எனவே இணைப்பது கட்டாயம்.

query: ఫిక్స్‌డ్ డిపాజిట్ మీద వచ్చే వడ్డీ మీద పన్ను పడుతుందా?
key_facts: Interest earned on FDs is taxable as per your income slab
TDS is deducted if FD interest exceeds the threshold
reference_answer: Income Tax Department ప్రకారం ఫిక్స్‌డ్ డిపాజిట్ మీద వచ్చే వడ్డీ మీ ఆదాయ శ్లాబ్ ప్రకారం పన్ను పరిధిలో ఉంటుంది, మరియు వడ్డీ పరిమితి దాటితే బ్యాంకు TDS మినహాయిస్తుంది.

query: म्युच्युअल फंडात SIP द्वारे गुंतवणूक कशी सुरू करावी?
key_facts: SIP lets you invest a fixed amount regularly in mutual funds
Mutual funds are regulated by SEBI and carry market risk
reference_answer: SEBI द्वारे नियंत्रित म्युच्युअल फंडात तुम्ही KYC पूर्ण करून SIP द्वारे दरमहा ठराविक रक्कम गुंतवू शकता; मात्र गुंतवणूक बाजार जोखमीच्या अधीन असते.

query: ਬੈਂਕ ਖਾਤੇ ਵਿੱਚ ਘੱਟੋ-ਘੱਟ ਬਕਾਇਆ ਨਾ ਰੱਖਣ 'ਤੇ ਕੀ ਚਾਰਜ ਲੱਗਦਾ ਹੈ?
key_facts: Banks may levy charges for not maintaining minimum balance
Basic savings (BSBDA) accounts have no minimum balance requirement
reference_answer: RBI ਅਨੁਸਾਰ ਬੈਂਕ ਘੱਟੋ-ਘੱਟ ਬਕਾਇਆ ਨਾ ਰੱਖਣ 'ਤੇ ਚਾਰਜ ਲਗਾ ਸਕਦੇ ਹਨ, ਪਰ Basic Savings (BSBDA) ਖਾਤੇ ਵਿੱਚ ਕੋਈ ਘੱਟੋ-ਘੱਟ ਬਕਾਇਆ ਲੋੜ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੁੰਦੀ।

query: ક્રેડિટ કાર્ડનું બિલ સમયસર ન ભરીએ તો શું થાય?
key_facts: Late credit card payment attracts high interest and late fees
It negatively affects your credit score
reference_answer: RBI મુજબ ક્રેડિટ કાર્ડનું બિલ સમયસર ન ભરવાથી ઊંચું વ્યાજ અને લેટ ફી લાગે છે અને તમારો ક્રેડિટ સ્કોર ઘટે છે.
